'''Jaylla Noh''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Agent from [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], who served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], she tasked a spacer to plant tracking devices on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire's equipment]]. That way, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] could track the Empire's movements and ensure that they left [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] for good.
